content: अमर्याद {%a.%} [<sab>न˚ ब˚</sab>] .²1 Exceeding due limits or bounds, transgressing every bound, disrespectful, improper; मर्यादायाममर्यादाः स्त्रियस्तिष्ठन्ति सर्वदा <ls>Pt. 1. 142</ls>; तादृशं त्वममर्यादं कर्म कर्तुं चिकीर्षसि <ls>Rām.</ls> .²2 Boundless, infinite. .{@-दा@} Transgression of due limits or bounds, impropriety of conduct, forwardness, disrespect, violation of due respect.
